  • 日本語名: ウィンターテイル～白の狂愛 黒の淫辱～
  • 英語名: Winter Tale Shiro no Kyouai Kuro no Injoku

あらすじ

Mikami Satoshi is caught in a snowstorm. He manages to find shelter at a nearby mansion.

In the mansion he meets two women who call themselves Aries and Erias.

Though he was going to stay only a short while, Satoshi finds himself fascinated by the women’s secret.
